# Calyxo AI Health Operating System
> Calyxo is an AI fitness and nutrition operating system featuring biometrics tracking, calorie calculations, structured workout logging, and real-time AI coaching.

## Primary Documentation & Features
- [Website](https://calyxo.vercel.app/): Interactive landing page and product features.
- [About](https://calyxo.vercel.app/user/about): Learn more about Calyxo.
